updates.detailed_summary_zh: 币安宣布将于2026年9月3日03:00（UTC）下架ICON（ICX）、Secret（SCRT）和Storj（STORJ）的所有现货交易对，并停止相关交易。币安表示这是基于最新审查结果的决定。 币安是全球最大的加密货币交易所，下架意味着这些代币失去一个主要的流动性和交易渠道。这可能会加大抛售压力，使持有者更难交易或退出头寸，也可能反映出合规或项目健康方面的隐忧。 下架适用于这三种代币的所有现货交易对，生效时间为2026年9月3日。这三者近期承压：ICX价格约0.016–0.017美元，SCRT约0.18欧元，STORJ约0.04美元，交易量相对有限。
updates.detailed_summary_en: Binance announced it will delist and cease trading for all spot trading pairs of ICON (ICX), Secret (SCRT), and Storj (STORJ) on September 3, 2026 at 03:00 UTC. The exchange cited its latest reviews for the decision. Binance is the world's largest cryptocurrency exchange, so delisting removes a major source of liquidity and trading access for these tokens. This could heighten selling pressure and make it harder for holders to trade or exit positions, and it may also signal compliance or project-health concerns. The delisting applies to all spot trading pairs for the three tokens and takes effect on 2026-09-03. Each token has been under pressure: ICX is trading around $0.016–0.017, SCRT around €0.18, and STORJ around $0.04 with relatively thin volumes.
